title: After-hours callback request (Blueprint Webhook #1)
description: What the website POSTs when a person asks for a callback. No last names, no email, no IP, no device ID. callbackNumber is TRANSIENT: kept only until the call connects or the TTL expires, then purged.

alias.description: Optional single first name or alias. One word only, so a last name can't be sent.

consent.description: Person agreed to a call back and to the number being deleted afterward.
